# Wei Car Spray Painting

> Wei Car Spray Painting Pte. Ltd. is a car spray painting and repair workshop at Blk 1017 Yishun Industrial Park A, Singapore 768759: panel spray painting, full resprays, scratch, dent and bumper repair, plus car servicing and repairs. Registered 28 June 2012 (UEN 201215981N).
